title: Book Three · Chapter 158: The Money They Set Aside
story:
Toward the end of the winter holiday, Mum and Dad sit down with Ronan's cost sheet.

Ronan has put his two personal envelopes on the table. One holds twenty-seven yuan from work. The other holds his twenty and a half from the book sale.

“Forty-seven and a half,” he says.

He adds the two amounts on the sheet but keeps the money in its separate envelopes. He copies today's date below the amounts.

Mum brings their household book. Dad has a page of his own work costs beside it.

They have looked at food, rent, and their ordinary needs. They also need room for Mum's work materials and Dad's tools.

“We can begin with twenty this month,” Mum says.

Dad puts twelve yuan on the table. Mum adds eight from her own money box.

They count it together and put it in a new envelope for study.

Ronan looks from the twenty to his own two envelopes.

“Sixty-seven and a half now.”

“Yes,” Dad says. “That is here. Later months are still later months.”

Mum writes the date and the two parents' amounts on the new envelope.

“We will check the household costs again next month. We want to keep helping.”

Ronan nods. They have not promised the whole fee today.

He moves the cost sheet closer. The first term's classes and room are two hundred and forty. Food and travel still need figures.

“There is a long way to go,” he says.

“There is time to ask,” Mum answers. “And time to save.”

Dad looks at the centre's letter.

“We need the whole plan before a payment.”

Ronan touches the edge of his work envelope.

“I want to learn this work. I don't only want to leave.”

Mum rests her hand beside the page.

“We know.”

For a moment, he cannot think of another question. Then Dad points to the blank food line.

“That one is still waiting.”

Ronan smiles and puts a small mark beside it.

They put the three envelopes away in their own places. His money remains his. The parents keep the new study envelope with the household book.

Before dinner, Mum opens the window a little. Dad brings in the bowls. Ronan clears the cost sheet from the table and sets their places.

The room smells of warm vegetables. He puts Mum's chair near her cushion and calls both of them to the meal before the food gets cold.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

household＝家庭日常生活的；rent＝房租；set aside＝留出、存下；payment＝付款。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan两份已知个人钱合计多少？父母本月实际各存多少、三份已存钱合计多少？
2. 未来月份的钱已经到账或整笔学费已经获保证了吗？父母还保留哪些自己的实际支出？

## 读句子

**His money remains his.**

拆开看：His money / remains / his.

他自己的钱／仍然／属于他自己。
